correctness.rationale: For a generic affine cut with k of m simplex vertices below its offset, k(m-k) crossed edges are exactly the slice vertices. Oriented Haar normals and Lebesgue offsets weight rank-k normal directions by their consecutive sorted-coordinate gap. Centered iid Gaussians yield the exact ratio of expected order-statistic spacings, validated by Tonelli integrals; the range weight is not mistakenly dropped. The range weighting converges in total variation to iid Gaussian by elementary normal extrema in L1. Gaussian tail/binomial concentration for fixed relative offset V rigorously proves log N_m/log m => 2-(2V-1)^2 and boundedness gives its mean. The extracted standalone Python checker passed 24 rank comparisons with independent invariant plane rejection sampling; finite experiments are diagnostic only.
